lesson: The system is consistently entering short positions into extreme oversold conditions, failing to account for mean reversion potential in a persistent markdown phase. By ignoring RSI exhaustion and local accumulation signals, the strategy is essentially chasing momentum at the exact point of liquidity exhaustion.
adjustment: Implement a 'No-Short' filter when RSI(14) on the 1h timeframe is below 25, requiring a confirmed bearish retest of a broken support level before entering.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI exhaustion signals MORE than EMA trend alignment during extreme oversold conditions.
